verses.1: A song for the mountains: I lift my eyes to the hills. From there, will come my help.
verses.2: Help me with the help of the LORD, who creates heaven and earth.
verses.3: Do not let the enemy take your feet; do not let them guard you.
verses.4: See, they will not sleep, nor will they rest in safety, for Israel.
verses.5: May the LORD protect you, O LORD! May He shield you with His right hand.
verses.6: The time of the sun will not cease to shine, and it will continue to fly through the night.
verses.7: May the LORD protect you from all evil. May He keep your soul safe.
verses.8: May the LORD protect your exits and entrances, from now on and forever.
